fields.definition: Durable Edison assets; not ephemeral URLs

infection_ever_person_risk.v1.numerator: distinct eligible agents ever infected within defined followup, including imported infection if named
infection_ever_person_risk.v1.denominator: distinct eligible agents in specified ever-aboard or boarding cohort
infection_ever_person_risk.v1.notes: First infection/person risk, not sum episodes; imported and aboard-acquired can overlap. Cannot substitute final I+R in an open/reinfection/multipathogen run.
infection_ever_person_risk.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

infection_aboard_person_risk.v1.numerator: distinct agents with >=1 aboard-acquired episode during window
infection_aboard_person_risk.v1.denominator: agents eligible for aboard acquisition under explicit susceptibility/reinfection rule
infection_aboard_person_risk.v1.notes: If denominator includes already-infected imports, label total-cohort risk; susceptible-at-start risk is a distinct estimand. Epoch-zero fiat seeds follow writer convention and must not silently become imports.
infection_aboard_person_risk.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

infection_import_person_fraction.v1.numerator: distinct agents carrying an infection at entry, with entry definition
infection_import_person_fraction.v1.notes: Boarding imports, later shore imports and supply-origin exposure are different channels. One person may import and reacquire; no subtraction to obtain acquired count without overlap.
infection_import_person_fraction.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

infection_episode_incidence_rate.v1.numerator: number of new infection episodes during window, excluding specified imported episodes
infection_episode_incidence_rate.v1.notes: Episodes != unique persons; recurrent-risk eligibility/version mandatory.
infection_episode_incidence_rate.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

symptomatic_course_risk.v1.numerator: distinct infected course-cohort persons whose complete relevant clinical course becomes symptomatic
symptomatic_course_risk.v1.notes: Needs saved future course/completed followup; incomplete courses censored or unavailable. Never infer from symptomatic epochs at voyage end.
symptomatic_course_risk.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

symptomatic_onboard_person_risk.v1.numerator: distinct eligible persons with >=1 symptomatic period while aboard during window
symptomatic_onboard_person_risk.v1.notes: Separate any-cause syndrome from pathogen-specific attributed symptoms. Boarding-symptomatic prevalence is separately labeled.
symptomatic_onboard_person_risk.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

symptomatic_onboard_burden.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

reported_true_person_risk.v1.numerator: distinct eligible symptomatic true-case persons ever reported during window
reported_true_person_risk.v1.denominator: explicit aboard or infected or symptomatic eligible cohort
reported_true_person_risk.v1.notes: Source symptomatic true-positive ID set is not all syndromic signals; observation feedback may change disease and test availability. Keep noise reports separate.
reported_true_person_risk.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

report_capture_given_symptoms.v1.notes: Condition set must be evaluated in the same window. Eventual symptomatic course does not equal report-eligible while aboard.
report_capture_given_symptoms.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

reported_noise_count.v1.numerator: distinct noise-case IDs or noise report events, explicitly named
reported_noise_count.v1.notes: Do not add unique noise persons to true-case persons unless disjoint IDs proved; raw observation count kept separately.
reported_noise_count.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

tested_person_fraction.v1.numerator: distinct eligible persons tested during window
tested_person_fraction.v1.notes: Tests, specimens, assays, positives and tested persons all separate; repeat tests do not add people.
tested_person_fraction.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

lab_confirmed_person_fraction.v1.numerator: distinct persons with qualifying lab-positive rule
lab_confirmed_person_fraction.v1.denominator: explicit test-eligible OR tested OR cohort population
lab_confirmed_person_fraction.v1.notes: Denominator choice creates separate metric IDs/condition IDs; turnaround, LOD, equivocal and repeat testing rules explicit.
lab_confirmed_person_fraction.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

test_positive_assay_fraction.v1.denominator: valid assays with known result by cutoff
test_positive_assay_fraction.v1.notes: Not agent AR; pending/censored/invalid tests listed separately.
test_positive_assay_fraction.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

posting_probability.v1.numerator: selected completed voyages meeting exact either-role reported-case threshold policy
posting_probability.v1.notes: Threshold/source version explicit; evaluate unrounded count >= ceil(threshold*N) for >= rule only when exact predicate agrees. Unknown passenger/crew complement blocks derived post, not zero.
posting_probability.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

outbreak_probability.v1.numerator: selected eligible voyages meeting versioned takeoff/outbreak predicate
outbreak_probability.v1.notes: Not interchangeable with posted, any infection, seed establishment, or VSP response trigger.
outbreak_probability.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

conditional_metric.v1.numerator: metric evaluated among units satisfying named post/outbreak/entry channel/minted/excursion conjunction
conditional_metric.v1.condition: explicit Boolean AST with conditioning grain
conditional_metric.v1.notes: Always publish unconditional alongside conditioned, P(condition), count eligible/observed/missing and policy feedback context; empty condition undefined not zero.
conditional_metric.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

case_entry_channel_fraction.v1.numerator: distinct qualifying cases in saved entry-channel category
case_entry_channel_fraction.v1.denominator: distinct qualifying cases across explicit exhaustive channel set
case_entry_channel_fraction.v1.notes: Boarding_import/supply_chain/aboard is reported-case mass-dominance classifier in current source, NOT a causal counterfactual fraction. Supply vs aboard ties follow writer; mixed fractions retained if saved.
case_entry_channel_fraction.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

case_dominant_route_fraction.v1.numerator: distinct established/reported cases assigned selected dominant route by saved rule
case_dominant_route_fraction.v1.denominator: matching assigned plus explicit unknown/unattributed cases as declared
case_dominant_route_fraction.v1.notes: Argmax acquired dose at establishment; route/channel and progression distinct. Retain tie/fallback/missing classification, and case counts not only percentages.
case_dominant_route_fraction.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

route_dose_share.v1.numerator: sum credited/acquired dose in route under one unit/pathogen definition
route_dose_share.v1.denominator: sum credited/acquired dose over declared routes
route_dose_share.v1.notes: Delivered vs credited separate; noncausal share. GEC/copies/PFU/aerosol mass incomparable absent validated conversion. Withdrawn absolute dose remains historical/qualified.
route_dose_share.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

mechanism_event_rate.v1.denominator: eligible person-hours or source opportunity count
mechanism_event_rate.v1.notes: Event count versus unique actors/recipients/source objects distinct. Multiple recipients per event not multiple independent voyages.
mechanism_event_rate.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

role_participation_fraction.v1.numerator: distinct role-members participating as actor/recipient/caregiver/etc. during window
role_participation_fraction.v1.denominator: distinct role-members eligible for that activity during window
role_participation_fraction.v1.notes: Role at event-time plus occupation and primary role; time-varying overlap unioned. Role complements alone cannot establish source/responder eligibility.
role_participation_fraction.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

role_participation_rate.v1.notes: One person can occupy several functions; no summing functional-role denominators as total crew.
role_participation_rate.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

source_realization_probability.v1.numerator: voyages or stations with >=1 realized source/object, separate units
source_realization_probability.v1.notes: Save nominal q, actual drawn q, station uniforms/witness if saved, realized counts and source IDs. No causal reclassification from infection endpoint.
source_realization_probability.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

conversion_post_given_excursion.v1.numerator: voyages posted AND exact excursion predicate holds
conversion_post_given_excursion.v1.notes: Legacy operational excursion is >=1 infection dominant-routed common_source_food. Minted object, nonzero delivered dose and early shared-dose exposure are DIFFERENT predicates.
conversion_post_given_excursion.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

ps01_D2_frozen_relative.v1.numerator: median posted passenger AR per in-band rung/hull
ps01_D2_frozen_relative.v1.denominator: in-campaign ind median at same hull/endpoint
ps01_D2_frozen_relative.v1.notes: Frozen interval [0.5,2]. Compute per-rung and any separately predeclared pooling. Source E25; operational absolute 0.04 table remains separate.
ps01_D2_frozen_relative.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

ps01_D2_operational_absolute.v1.numerator: median posted passenger AR per arm/hull
ps01_D2_operational_absolute.v1.notes: Legacy reporter >=0.04 edge. Does NOT resolve frozen D2; endpoint mapping of pax-AR must be confirmed in source version.
ps01_D2_operational_absolute.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

ps01_D3_frozen_converted_AR.v1.numerator: median converted-pax-AR among posted voyages pooled in-band per hull
ps01_D3_frozen_converted_AR.v1.notes: BLOCKED_DEFINITION: design does not fully specify converted-pax-AR numerator/population. Do NOT substitute excursion->posting probability or guess aboard/food-route AR. Preserve candidate raw counts and obtain explicit definition adjudication; report unresolved gate.
ps01_D3_frozen_converted_AR.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

ps01_D3_operational_conversion.v1.notes: Empty excursion or zero ind conversion -> undefined reason; no 0/0 default. Separate probability components and paired changes.
ps01_D3_operational_conversion.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

burst_acquisition_closed_W.v1.numerator: maximum number acquisitions within [t,t+W] over saved acquisition times
burst_acquisition_closed_W.v1.denominator: number acquisitions included in same exact filter
burst_acquisition_closed_W.v1.notes: Legacy closed span <=W includes both endpoints; W=48 epochs is not necessarily 48h. Unit/clock and e>0 filter explicit. Ties choose earliest maximizing left boundary. If no acquisitions: undefined/no_events, retain legacy zero in native scalar only. Count episodes vs persons follows saved acquisition schema.
burst_acquisition_closed_W.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

burst_observed_onset_halfopen_W.v1.numerator: maximum number qualifying observed onsets in [t,t+W)
burst_observed_onset_halfopen_W.v1.notes: New proposed physical-hour endpoint, NOT a rename of acquisition burst. Inferred interval onsets yield bounds/interval method not invented exact times. Window type, alignment and minimum count frozen.
burst_observed_onset_halfopen_W.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

response_delay.v1.notes: Endpoint exact/left/right/interval censor and competing events retained. peak_epoch-detection_epoch is lead-time-to-peak, NOT onset-to-detection delay; negative values can be meaningful.
response_delay.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

economic_cost_per_case_averted.v1.notes: Use exact cost currency year, opportunity units and paired seeds. Zero/negative denominator reported, not infinity hidden or favorable-only ratios; effect requires valid intervention contrast.
economic_cost_per_case_averted.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

surveillance_detection_probability.v1.numerator: eligible voyages/lineages detected by deadline under observed channel
surveillance_detection_probability.v1.denominator: all eligible latent-introduction or risk-set units at stated grain
surveillance_detection_probability.v1.notes: Observed vs truth channels, specimen sampling and information feedback explicit; lineage census and observed sequence line list not merged as observations.
surveillance_detection_probability.v1.aggregation: Keep exact per-run numerator/denominator/value; define mean-run versus pooled versus hierarchy explicitly.

controlled_vocabularies.capability_rule: Availability must be scoped by run/member/version. Mixed full/lean populations never get an all-available silent pass.
controlled_vocabularies.value_statuses_integrated_namespace: Narrative evidence/read aliases only; NOT metrics.value_status or a shared status enum. See STATUS_NAMESPACES.json for evidence-qualified conversion.
controlled_vocabularies.typed_read_states_namespace: source_objects.read_state only; translate to assets.read_state plus data_gaps.reason/detail, never assign these read reasons directly to scientific enums.

invariants: All table rows satisfy declared grain; primary key uniqueness checked before aggregation.
The same uncompressed run member found in per-run and fused archives is an asset alias, not a second replicate. A retry with different bytes remains a distinct execution.
All unique selected completed run counts reconcile catalog, selection ledger and reduction outputs; failures/partial/unreachable separate.
All null substantive fields have typed gap records or explicit structural optionality; no NaN/Inf emitted as scientific values.
Role complement sums checked only when primary roles exhaustive/disjoint and same population/time. Overlapping occupation/function memberships never summed as exhaustive totals.
0 <= unique-case numerator <= matching at-risk cohort for a person-risk estimand. Event/episode counts may exceed people only with distinct metric units.
Imported and aboard-acquired counts overlap if reacquisition occurs; total ever = import union aboard, not import + aboard unless disjointness proved.
Reporting channel/route counts sum to corresponding true reported cases only under proved exhaustive partition with explicit unknown bucket.
Cumulative counters monotone only within fixed cohort/definition with no resets; departures and changing denominators require intervals, not positive-I+R incidence.
Person-hours are sums of disjoint interval unions clipped to eligibility and actual followup; negative durations or double-counted role intervals reject.
Censor records obey bounds and entry <= exit; administrative right censor, competing exit, never-at-risk and structural nonoccurrence distinct.
Weights finite nonnegative, named/date target-qualified; total valid weight >0; missing weight target blocks fleet aggregate only.
Seed pairing requires design/attempt/random-stream evidence, explicit unmatched rows and actual source bridge; accidental numeric seed equality is not pairing.
Query joins must preserve declared unit or explicitly change estimand; multiplying scalar rows by event/agent rows cannot create independent replicates.
Every output retains actual input/source/definition/reducer/analysis identity and missingness; doc SHA is not assumed execution SHA.
No scalar ECDF or mean imputes missing/censored/nonoccurred timing as zero or terminal horizon.
No external AGE fraction is multiplied into simulated norovirus outcomes; external transformations remain external and uncertainty-propagated.
If exact integer numerator/denominator exceeds float64 exact integer range, keep int64/decimal/native exact token and leave lossy numeric projection null with status; no silent precision loss.
Physical object counts use source_objects distinct object_id; members, design cells, executions, selected voyages and posterior draws are separate units.
source_links provides many-to-many provenance; no dedup across scientific attempts on seed, prefix, basename or byte equality alone.

null_policy.required_columns: Every declared column is present in Parquet schema; every JSON row key is present.
null_policy.substantive_null: Requires data_gaps entry on table/row/field or selector range.
structural_null_exceptions: source_asset_id for pure derivation/declaration with analysis lineage
optional linkage fields with no applicable relationship: parent asset, episode, object, membership, source/bridge/parent observation, feedback action
timing infinity bounds only as explicitly implied by censor_type
projection numeric when original scalar is nonnumeric; exact token absent if numerator/denominator itself structurally absent
role-specific field for explicitly all-population row
null_policy.unknown_not_exception: Unknown values still require a typed gap; structurally absent does not mean unknown.
